WITH Combined AS (
    SELECT
        CASE @granularity
            WHEN N'daily' THEN CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), S_DATE, 120)
            WHEN N'monthly' THEN CONVERT(VARCHAR(7), S_DATE, 120) + '-01'
            WHEN N'yearly' THEN CONVERT(VARCHAR(4), S_DATE, 120) + '-01-01'
        END AS periodStart,
        SUM(QTY) AS soldBaseQuantity,
        SUM(((((PRICE * QTY) + (ISNULL(COLOR_PRICE, 0) * QTY)) - ((((PRICE * QTY) + (ISNULL(COLOR_PRICE, 0) * QTY)) * ISNULL(S_DISCOUNT, 0) / 100)) + ((((PRICE * QTY) + (ISNULL(COLOR_PRICE, 0) * QTY)) - ((((PRICE * QTY) + (ISNULL(COLOR_PRICE, 0) * QTY)) * ISNULL(S_DISCOUNT, 0) / 100))) * ISNULL(S_TAX1, 0) / 100) + (((((PRICE * QTY) + (ISNULL(COLOR_PRICE, 0) * QTY)) - ((((PRICE * QTY) + (ISNULL(COLOR_PRICE, 0) * QTY)) * ISNULL(S_DISCOUNT, 0) / 100)) + ((((PRICE * QTY) + (ISNULL(COLOR_PRICE, 0) * QTY)) - ((((PRICE * QTY) + (ISNULL(COLOR_PRICE, 0) * QTY)) * ISNULL(S_DISCOUNT, 0) / 100))) * ISNULL(S_TAX1, 0) / 100)) * ISNULL(S_TAX2, 0) / 100))) AS netAmount,
        SUM(((PRICE * QTY) + (ISNULL(COLOR_PRICE, 0) * QTY)) * ISNULL(S_DISCOUNT, 0) / 100) AS discountAmount,
        COUNT(DISTINCT S_ID) AS invoiceCount
    FROM SALE_ITEMS_INVOICE_VIEW
    WHERE ITEM_ID = @productId
      AND S_STATUES NOT IN (0, 2)
      AND S_DATE >= @startDate
      AND S_DATE < DATEADD(day, 1, @endDate)
    GROUP BY CASE @granularity
        WHEN N'daily' THEN CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), S_DATE, 120)
        WHEN N'monthly' THEN CONVERT(VARCHAR(7), S_DATE, 120) + '-01'
        WHEN N'yearly' THEN CONVERT(VARCHAR(4), S_DATE, 120) + '-01-01'
    END

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        CASE @granularity
            WHEN N'daily' THEN CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), S_R_DATE, 120)
            WHEN N'monthly' THEN CONVERT(VARCHAR(7), S_R_DATE, 120) + '-01'
            WHEN N'yearly' THEN CONVERT(VARCHAR(4), S_R_DATE, 120) + '-01-01'
        END AS periodStart,
        -SUM(QTY) AS soldBaseQuantity,
        -SUM(PRICE * QTY) AS netAmount,
        CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(18, 4)) AS discountAmount,
        CAST(0 AS INT) AS invoiceCount
    FROM R_S_ITEMS_INVOICE_VIEW
    WHERE ITEM_ID = @productId
      AND S_R_STATUES NOT IN (0, 2)
      AND S_R_DATE >= @startDate
      AND S_R_DATE < DATEADD(day, 1, @endDate)
    GROUP BY CASE @granularity
        WHEN N'daily' THEN CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), S_R_DATE, 120)
        WHEN N'monthly' THEN CONVERT(VARCHAR(7), S_R_DATE, 120) + '-01'
        WHEN N'yearly' THEN CONVERT(VARCHAR(4), S_R_DATE, 120) + '-01-01'
    END
)
SELECT
    periodStart,
    periodStart AS periodEnd,
    SUM(soldBaseQuantity) AS soldBaseQuantity,
    SUM(netAmount) AS netAmount,
    SUM(discountAmount) AS discountAmount,
    SUM(invoiceCount) AS invoiceCount
FROM Combined
WHERE periodStart IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY periodStart
ORDER BY periodStart ASC;
